name: expense-webapp
description: One single-page app for the three roles: employees create, edit, submit and withdraw claims; managers work a team queue and approve or reject; Finance reports on all claims, downloads CSVs and runs payroll exports. One bundle because all roles share one sign-in and one visual shell; it holds no data of its own and calls only expense-api.

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Loads and changes claims, decisions, reports and payroll exports.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Single sign-on; the app gates each screen on the operation it loads.
